title: Verify Administrator can access all Settings sub-sections
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has all Settings sub-toggles ON).
steps:
1. Click the Settings (cog) icon.
2. Open App Settings.
3. Open the Service sub-section.
4. Open the Parts sub-section.
5. Open the Finance sub-section.
6. Open the Data Import sub-section.
7. Open the Wages sub-section.
expected: All six sub-sections (App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, Wages) are visible and open successfully.
